# 🚀 Deployment Checklist

- [ ] Exposed provider credentials rotated and prior usage reviewed.
- [ ] Secrets are provided by a platform secret manager.
- [ ] Data provenance, license, and consent are documented.
- [ ] Privacy notice matches actual data flows.
- [ ] Upload size and content validation are implemented.
- [ ] PDF parsing is real and tested, or PDF is not advertised.
- [ ] Model and label encoder versions are verified.
- [ ] Provider requests have finite timeouts and safe error handling.
- [ ] Provider content is escaped and URLs validated.
- [ ] Python and dependency versions are documented.
- [ ] CI and focused tests pass.
- [ ] Access, logs, retention, deletion, and incident steps reviewed.
- [ ] Accessibility smoke test completed.
- [ ] Rollback and service-disable steps tested.

This is an operational checklist, not legal or regulatory certification.
